description_en: You can create different asset groups based on your business requirements, add assets of the same type to an asset group, and manage assets by category and perform batch operations
description_zh: 您可以按照业务需要创建不同的资产组，然后将同一类型的资产添加到资产组，实现对资产的分类管理和批量操作
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-host-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-group-name HostGroup01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateHostGroup

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host where you want to create the asset group.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定新建资产组所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host instance where you want to create the asset group.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定新建资产组所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the asset group. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定新建的资产组名称，最多支持128字符
parameters.name: host_group_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the asset group. The description can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定新建资产组的备注信息，最多支持500字符
parameters.name: comment

HostGroupId.description_en: The ID of the created asset group

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
